judge_input.description:
see the commits that are sitting down below here in this spot. Basically, what it is that I am going about doing here is that I am reworking the whole of this in such a way as to go ahead and drop the cruft right out of our fedora-coreos-config, and the particular situation that exists over on that side of things is that there happens to be an awfully large amount of duplication that is just sitting there in it as things currently stand. Now, as for the reason that the whole of that duplication happens to be sitting there in the first place at all, that reason comes down entirely to the fact that we have, for a good while now, been going along and supporting both of two entirely different things at one and the same time as each other: on the one hand of it, there is the old style way of going about it, which is to say `cosa build`, and then, over on the other hand of it, there is the newer build via container way of going about the very same thing, which is to say the `cosa build-with-buildah` builds.

commit 22bb4c2a1c02d3d59ad8a840b31bb376a3271d3f
Author: Dusty Mabe <dusty@dustymabe.com>
Date:   Tue Dec 9 16:35:36 2025 -0500

    add python3-dotenv to deps
    
    The particular thing that it is that we want to go ahead and do here in
    this instance is to go and make use of this library right here, and the
    specific purpose that we are wanting to make use of it for is so that
    we can go ahead and parse the build-args.conf file with it. As for that
    file, the thing about it is that it is really and truly nothing more at
    all than simply just environment variables, and those variables are
    ones that are sitting there in the var=val format, and that is all that
    there is to it.

commit bc55ead4be4160c0afd7c1231a4b8d891c50f5dc
Author: Dusty Mabe <dusty@dustymabe.com>
Date:   Tue Dec 9 16:32:34 2025 -0500

    move some manifest parsed env vars to cmd-build
    
    These particular ones that we are talking about here are ones that only
    ever end up being used over inside of cmd-build and nowhere else at all
    besides that one place, and so, that being the case, what we may just
    as well go ahead and do about it is to move the whole lot of them over
    there into cmd-build where they properly belong. The entire reason that
    we would go and do a thing like that, of course, is so as to make it a
    very good deal more explicit than it currently is exactly where it is
    that these things are actually being used.

commit ef1b4fbbbd1882aaf6f8b8d0a6bbe059914cfbd1
Author: Dusty Mabe <dusty@dustymabe.com>
Date:   Tue Dec 9 15:19:07 2025 -0500

    cmdlib: drop requirement for automatic-version-prefix in the manifest
    
    The general direction that we happen to be heading off in these days is
    that we are in the process of moving ourselves away from the greater
    part of the rpm-ostree high level features, and this particular one
    right here that is at issue happens to be one of those very features
    that we are moving away from. It is, moreover, one that we no longer
    really have any genuine need for at all anymore, or at any rate not in
    the build-via-container world that we now find ourselves living in as
    of today.

commit e90ae1900ae78548d3bcb64347a6e40123120f6a
Author: Dusty Mabe <dusty@dustymabe.com>
Date:   Tue Dec 9 14:47:22 2025 -0500

    cmd-build-with-buildah: trim log statement
    
    The way that I myself happen to feel about this whole matter is that I
    find the `...` that is sitting there on the very end of this statement
    to be genuinely annoying to have hanging around there. The thing that
    it ends up doing is that it goes and makes the whole business a good
    deal harder than it needs to be to copy/paste the version right out of
    it, at least in that case where I happened to have wanted to go ahead
    and do such a thing in the first place, and then, over and above just
    that on its own, it additionally goes and makes the whole thing harder
    for my own human brain to go and properly process as well, right into
    the bargain along with everything else.

diff --git a/src/cmd-build b/src/cmd-build
index 985d0d3f4f..64668fe984 100755
--- a/src/cmd-build
+++ b/src/cmd-build
@@ -24,7 +24,7 @@ Usage: coreos-assembler build --help
   --strict              Only allow installing locked packages when using lockfiles
   --prepare-only        Do not actually build, only set things up so that `rpm-ostree compose image` works.
   --tag TAG             Set the given tag in the build metadata
-  --version=VERSION     Use the given version instead of following the manifest's `automatic-version-prefix`.
+  --version=VERSION     Use the given version instead of following automatic versioning.
   --versionary          Use the versionary script from the source config to drive version.
   --skip-config-archive Disable creating a tar.gz archive of the config repo.
   --autolock=VERSION    If no base lockfile used, create one from any arch build of `VERSION`.
@@ -148,6 +148,14 @@ done
 
 prepare_build
 
+# Use metadata.name as the name of the VM images
+# Also grab metadata.summary for image upload descriptions
+# XXX: delete the rojig fallbacks once we've moved over to metadata
+name=$(jq -r '.metadata.name//.rojig.name' < "${flattened_manifest}")
+summary=$(jq -r '.metadata.summary//.rojig.summary' < "${flattened_manifest}")
+ref=$(jq -r '.ref//""' < "${flattened_manifest}")
+export name ref summary
+
 ostree --version
 rpm-ostree --version

@@ -105,7 +105,7 @@ if [ -z "${VERSION}" ]; then
 fi

-    echo "Building with container runtime (buildah) with VERSION=${VERSION}..."
+    echo "Building with container runtime (buildah) with VERSION=${VERSION}"
 
     # Allocate temporary space for this build

     export flattened_manifest
 
-    # Use metadata.name as the name of the VM images

-    # XXX: delete the rojig fallbacks once we've moved over to metadata
-    name=$(jq -r '.metadata.name//.rojig.name' < "${flattened_manifest}")
-    summary=$(jq -r '.metadata.summary//.rojig.summary' < "${flattened_manifest}")
-    ref=$(jq -r '.ref//""' < "${flattened_manifest}")
-    export name ref summary
-    # And validate fields coreos-assembler requires, but not rpm-ostree
-    required_fields=("automatic-version-prefix")
-    for field in "${required_fields[@]}"; do
-        if ! jq -re '."'"${field}"'"' < "${flattened_manifest}" >/dev/null; then
-            echo "Missing required field in src/config/manifest.yaml: ${field}" 1>&2
-            exit 1
-        fi
-    done
-
     # This dir is no longer used
     rm builds/work -rf
 
diff --git a/src/deps.txt b/src/deps.txt
index 81aa1b0c7b..8f8fa4d0d8 100644
--- a/src/deps.txt
+++ b/src/deps.txt
@@ -114,3 +114,6 @@ kustomize
 
 # For vimdiff
 vim-enhanced
+

judge_input.title: drop automatic-version-prefix req; add python3-dotenv to deps
